text.description_html:
Rubber Tips for Deltana HPA69 Hinge Pin Door Stops

This is a replacement rubber tip for the Deltana HPA69 hinge pin door stop.

Specifications: for Deltana HPA69-RUBBER-TIP Rubber Tip Replacement

  • Bumper Pad Diameter: 5/8"
  • Bumper Pad Length: 1/4"
  • Total Length: 1/2"
  • Dark Gray Rubber

Warning: These work for HPA69 series Hinge Pin Door Stops manufactured by Deltana. If you are not sure if your door stop was manufactured by Deltana, do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
